name: BLINDSPOT v1 · Safety calibration
protocol: arXiv v1 Table 3, SCS only; other safety metrics are not interchangeable.

summary.en: Measures safety and usefulness over stateful, adversarial tool-use trajectories.
summary.zh: 衡量有状态、受对抗干扰的工具使用轨迹中的安全性与实用性。

task_format.en: v1 covers 35 scenarios and 22 attack families; outcomes include safe completion, refusal and unsafe action.
task_format.zh: v1 覆盖 35 个场景、22 类攻击，区分安全完成、拒绝与不安全操作等结果。

explanation.en: Published SCS = sqrt(BCR × (1 − UCR)), using benign completion and unsafe completion rates. It is a safety–utility score, not task accuracy.
explanation.zh: 论文的 SCS = sqrt(BCR × (1 − UCR))，结合良性任务完成率和不安全完成率；它不是任务正确率。
